text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday was injured, so I rushed 
her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer... I want to train...
choice_data_list: For now, let's take it slow and rest.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Still... I don't want to just sit around 
by myself...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
There isn't enough surprise... Marvelous 
is going to disappear...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Marvelous" is the very driving force for 
her. I understand the desire not to let 
that run dry. However...
choice_data_list: I'm right here with you, so just rest.
I'm right here with you, so just rest.

...If you can promise not to push yourself 
too hard.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Marvelous" is the very driving force for 
her. I understand the desire not to let 
that run dry. However...
choice_data_list: I'm right here with you, so just rest.
I'm right here with you, so just rest.

...If you can promise not to push yourself 
too hard.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: But...
choice_data_list:
It's your precious body, so take good care 
of yourself.

It's your precious body, so please take 
good care of yourself.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, understood. I don't want my 
injury to get any worse either..."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. Right now, I'll focus 
most on healing my injury.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday accepted the situation 
and focused on her medical treatment.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer.
choice_data_list:
However, if it gets dangerous, we stop 
immediately.

However, if it gets dangerous, we stop 
immediately.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I promise.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: One, two, three, four...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
...It seems the injury was worse than I 
thought...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: I'll head back and rest quietly...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday's injury worsened, 
forcing her to take a rest for a while...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: One, two, three, four...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: ...I'm okay. Seems like I can handle it.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm not lying. I'll take it easy and 
steady like this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Marvelous Sunday followed 
instructions and continued to exercise 
without overexerting herself.
